english.title: Purport to be official entitled to enter premises or vessel under Water Industry Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without having been designated or authorised for the purpose by a relevant undertaker, purported to be entitled to enter

(A)_[premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(B)_[a vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..),]_

in exercise of a power exercisable in pursuance of such a designation or authorisation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 173(1) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
without having been designated or authorised for the purpose by a relevant undertaker,
purported to be entitled to enter premises or a vessel
in exercise of a power exercisable in pursuance of such a designation or authorisation
under Chapter 1 of Part VI of the Water Industry Act 1991

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For the purposes of section 173, it shall be immaterial, where a person purports to be entitled to enter any premises or vessel, that the power which that person purports to be entitled to exercise does not exist or would not be exercisable even if that person had been designated or authorised by a relevant undertaker. Section 173(2)
